observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a large, dirty, metallic automotive component lying on a dark floor, likely in a workshop or garage.
The component has a ribbed, rectangular shape with a central vertical seam and multiple bolt holes and mounting points.
There are visible signs of rust, grime, and wear, especially on the top and sides.
A yellow sticker is affixed to the surface, but the text is not legible.
Various hoses, wires, and metal brackets are attached or connected to the component.
The component appears to be a transmission or gearbox, given its size, shape, and mounting points.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the component itself.
The seller claims it is an 'American drive Gearbox ford transit V6'.
